name: Bradda Head Lithium Limited
summary: Operating through its various subsidiaries, Bradda Head Lithium Limited is dedicated to the exploration, development, and eventual mining of lithium deposits across the United States. The company holds full ownership of several key lithium ventures in Arizona. This includes the Basin East property, which encompasses approximately 3.78 square kilometers in central western Arizona. Also situated in central western Arizona is Basin West, an asset covering roughly 6.02 square kilometers through 65 placer mining and 72 lode claims. Additionally, in Mohave County, Arizona, the Wikieup project comprises 120 federal placer mining claims and 225 lode claims, spanning a considerable 27.87 square kilometers. Beyond these, Bradda Head Lithium's portfolio extends to the Wilson Salt Flat, a lithium brine project located in Nye County, Nevada, and the Eureka lithium brine project, which measures 11.8 square kilometers. The company also manages the San Domingo project in Arizona's Maricopa and Yavapai counties, an area of approximately 13.5 square kilometers secured by 68 BLM placer claims. Headquartered in Douglas, Isle of Man, the company adopted its current name, Bradda Head Lithium Limited, in September 2021, having previously operated as Bradda Head Holdings Limited.
